services.label: eScript / prescription
services.ackText: We do not prescribe medications of addiction or restricted medicines, including S4 and S8 medications. This includes (but is not limited to) strong pain medications such as Panadeine Forte, Endone, Targin, Palexia, Temgesic and Norspan; benzodiazepines; ADHD medications; gabapentinoids such as Lyrica; antipsychotic medications such as quetiapine; and testosterone. Some medications may require an assessment before they can be prescribed. The decision to prescribe any medication is made at the discretion of the consulting practitioner based on your clinical circumstances. Please do not proceed if you are specifically seeking any of the above or other restricted medicines. We also do not provide multiple repeats simply on request — the number of repeats, if any, is determined by the treating doctor based on your clinical needs.

services.label: Medical certificate
services.ex: For work, study or carer's leave
services.ackText:
Medical certificates can only be issued for circumstances that are appropriately assessed during your consultation. We do not provide backdated certificates or certificates covering dates before the day of your consultation.

We also do not provide medical certificates for:
• Centrelink purposes
• Cancelling bookings, events or appointments
• Rescheduling or cancelling travel plans
• Legal or court-related matters

If you require a medical certificate, the consulting doctor will determine whether one can be provided based on your consultation and clinical assessment.

services.label: Referral letter
services.ackText:
Our telehealth service provides referral letters to private specialists only. We do not provide referral letters to public hospitals through this service.

If you require an urgent assessment at a public hospital, you should attend the appropriate emergency department or contact the relevant health service directly.
